Class KotlinSourceCompiler

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.dev.compile.StagedSourceCompiler
io.micronaut.dev.compile.KotlinSourceCompiler
All Implemented Interfaces:
SourceCompiler, Closeable, AutoCloseable
public final class KotlinSourceCompiler extends StagedSourceCompiler
The embedded Kotlin compiler: kotlinc through the Kotlin Build Tools API, preceded by KSP when the project has symbol processors, run incrementally by StagedSourceCompiler. Available when the Build Tools API and its implementation are on the launch classpath; the module does not depend on them, and the build plugin puts them there at the project's Kotlin and KSP versions.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
graemerocher

    • compilesEmptyBatches

      protected boolean compilesEmptyBatches()
      Description copied from class: StagedSourceCompiler
      Whether a batch that selects no source to compile, one that only deletes sources, still runs StagedSourceCompiler.runCompilation(CompilationRequest, Set, Set, Path, Path, List), with an empty set: a compiler whose processors keep state between runs and regenerate what depends on every source, as KSP does, needs to see the deletion, and what the run produces replaces what the deleted sources produced. By default such a batch only removes.
